finding.title: Projection snapshot readers remained read-write after verify/status repair
finding.consequence: Briefing, formation, outbox and UI projections used a writable connection through verified_snapshot, leaving an observational path outside the first repair.
finding.required_repair: Make iter_events and verified_snapshot explicitly read-only and keep all four observation paths under one regression.

nonclaim: Connection-mode coverage extension only; no actual evidence mutation is claimed.
